levels.surface: الحاكم أبو علي الحسين بن أحمدالبيهقي

groups.saying_opens: إن الله عز وجل لا يسأل عباده
يا علي إن أول ما يسأل عنه

notes: Three sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): Ridha's answer on bliss (the Imam speaks in the story), the Imam's own transmission of the saying on what God does not ask about, and the Prophet's words to Ali.
«أبيه علي بن الحسين» is one link (rule 7); the last «أبيه علي» is Ali, who relays the Prophet's words. Occurrence numbers count standalone words.

Left out as story or remark: Abu Dhakwan's dream account (فَقَالَ لِي ابْنُ ذَكْوَانَ ...), the jurist's question and al-Suli's remark (قَالَ الصَّوْلِيُّ). «الحاكم أبو علي الحسين بن أحمدالبيهقي» is written as it stands in the text (no space).
